summary: The latest discussion proposes updating the Parquet row group size recommendation, moving away from the outdated 512MB-1GB range. It suggests a set of tradeoffs that consider pruning, parallelism, writer memory, and footer size to balance performance and resource usage.

highlights.text: Update row group size recommendation to replace the 512MB-1GB range with tradeoffs based on pruning, parallelism, writer memory, and footer size
